title: Metal Fabrication Machinery Supplier in Canada | NovoTech
meta_description: Press brakes, fiber lasers, band saws, rebar benders, plate rollers, ironworkers and deburring machines — sold, installed and supported in Canada from Mississauga, ON, Canada.
intro: Press brakes, fiber lasers, band saws, rebar benders, plate rollers, ironworkers, deburring machines and press brake tooling from manufacturers in Turkey, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, Taiwan and China. Every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, and NovoTech installs it, trains your operators and keeps the parts in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.
hero_points: Showroom and parts warehouse in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada
CSA-approved electrical panel and a 1-year warranty on every machine
Installation, operator training and technical support anywhere in Canada

intro_video.title: NovoTech Machine Tools — who we are and what we sell

quote.intro: Tell us what you need to cut, bend, roll or finish — material, thickness, length and how many parts — and we will recommend the machine and come back with pricing, delivery and the right voltage for your shop.

work_slides.title: Press brakes
work_slides.line: CNC hydraulic, hybrid and servo-electric press brakes from 22 to 1,323 US tons and 4 to 20 ft.

work_slides.title: Fiber laser cutting machines
work_slides.line: Sheet and plate fiber lasers from 4 × 4 ft to 10 × 164 ft and 1.5 to 80 kW, with shuttle tables, loaders and sorting.

work_slides.title: Band saws
work_slides.line: Manual, semi-automatic, automatic and double-column band saws from Ø9″ to 87″ — whole bundles in one cut.

work_slides.title: Shears
work_slides.line: Hydraulic guillotine and swing beam shears, CNC and NC, and mechanical shears — from 16 ga sheet to 1-9/16″ plate, 4 to 20 ft long.

work_slides.title: Angle rolls and section benders
work_slides.line: From a 2 HP ring roller to HEB 600 beam benders — rings, arcs and spirals in pipe, tube, angle and flat bar.

work_slides.kicker: Roll plate into cylinders and cones
work_slides.title: Plate rollers
work_slides.line: Hydraulic 4-roll and 3-roll plate rolls to 20 ft and 3-3/8″ plate, NC and CNC, plus motorized rolls from 3.4 ft.

work_slides.title: Ironworkers
work_slides.line: Hydraulic ironworkers from 44 to 276 US tons: punch plate, shear flat bar and angle, notch — single- and double-piston.

work_slides.title: Rebar benders and cutters
work_slides.line: Stationary and portable rebar benders, hydraulic cutters, stirrup and spiral benders and automatic lines, #3 to #18.

work_slides.title: Pipe and tube benders
work_slides.line: CNC, NC, all-electric and hydraulic mandrel and rotary-draw benders, from Ø15/32″ tube to Ø8-5/8″ pipe.

work_slides.title: Tube laser cutting machines
work_slides.line: Round, square and rectangular tube, angle, channel and beam from Ø0.3″ to 25.2″ in 20 to 40 ft bars — with automatic loaders, zero-tail chucks and bevel heads.

work_slides.title: Sheet metal brakes and folders
work_slides.line: Hand, box and pan, magnetic and roofing brakes up to hydraulic, electric and CNC folding machines — up to 20 ft.

work_slides.title: Deburring and finishing machines
work_slides.line: Dry and wet machines that deburr, round the edges and finish laser-, plasma- and punch-cut parts, 5-7/8″ to 53-1/8″ wide.

work_slides.title: Pipe sanding and polishing machines
work_slides.line: Tube sanders and pipe polishers for straight and bent tube — automatic feed, orbital, centreless and large-pipe sanders.
